drums.tags: Boom bap hip hop instrumental at 92 BPM in the key of C minor. The track is built around a dusty, four-bar jazz piano loop featuring minor ninth chords and a melodic top-line flourish. The drum kit consists of a thumping, slightly off-grid kick drum, a crisp snare with a short reverb tail, and shuffled sixteenth-note hi-hats. A warm, filtered electric bass follows the root notes of the piano progression with a slight swing. Occasional vinyl crackle and hiss are layered throughout the arrangement. A secondary melodic element consists of a muted trumpet sample with a wah-wah filter that appears during transition points. The arrangement follows a repetitive loop structure typical of 90s East Coast production.
